proposed_fixes.title: Make SVG thumbnail backgrounds independent of Windows color mode
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Recent reports indicate that the SVG thumbnail renderer applies a dark theme background, making dark artwork appear as a black or blank thumbnail even though preview rendering still works.
plan: Trace the SVG thumbnail provider background and theme selection used by File Explorer thumbnails.
Render thumbnails against a stable transparent or configurable light background instead of inheriting a background that hides dark artwork.
Add coverage for dark SVG artwork under Windows light and dark modes and verify cache refresh behavior.
verification: Generate thumbnails for light and dark SVG samples in both Windows color modes and confirm both remain visible after Explorer refresh and cache rebuild.
